description: Machine-readable summary of Seattle building permits, land use Master Use Permits, trade permits, housing units under construction, and 2014 to 2026 historical trends from City of Seattle SDCI Open Data.

permitTypes.building: Structural construction, new houses, apartments, additions, remodels, shoring, and demolitions reviewed for building code safety (76t5-zqzr).
permitTypes.landUse: Master Use Permits (MUPs), zoning approvals, design review, environmental review, and lot subdivisions required before building larger or complex projects (ht3q-kdvx).
permitTypes.trade: Mechanical (HVAC), electrical, plumbing and side sewer, boiler, elevator, and refrigeration systems installed inside or connected to buildings (c87v-5hwh).

housingCategories.Large Multifamily: Mid-rise and high-rise apartment, condominium, and mixed-use residential buildings with larger unit counts.
housingCategories.Middle Housing: Townhomes, duplexes, triplexes, fourplexes, stacked flats, and cottage housing between single-family homes and large apartments.
housingCategories.Single-Family Add/Alt: Additions, interior remodels, basement conversions, and attached accessory dwelling units (ADUs) on single-family lots.
housingCategories.Commercial Add/Alt: Tenant improvements, structural remodels, and residential-over-retail conversions inside commercial buildings.
housingCategories.Pre-Approved DADU Plans: Detached backyard cottages (detached accessory dwelling units) built using SDCI fast-track pre-reviewed plan library.
housingCategories.Multifamily (Other): Live-work conversions, congregate residences, boarding houses, and specialized multifamily alterations.

meta.source: City of Seattle Open Data Portal (data.seattle.gov)
